  "text": "The customer had brought the trousers in on Tuesday and said there was no hurry, provided they were ready by Friday. Mara wrote Thursday on the ticket. She preferred to leave herself a day for people who remembered weddings late.

‘Bring the coat,’ she had said.

‘There’s nothing wrong with the coat.’

‘I need to see the size.’

He said he would look in the drawer first. There was a tin her mother had used for buttons, although since his move it might have contained screws. Mara waited while he went to check. Through the receiver she heard him set something down, then open and close a drawer.

The telephone rang beneath a length of lining fabric. Mara put the iron upright and reached behind the board for the plug.

The caller asked whether she was somewhere she could talk. Mara gave the name of the shop, thinking at first that it concerned a delivery.

She listened with the receiver against one ear and her free hand resting on the counter. When the woman repeated the hospital’s name, Mara said she knew it. She took her coat from the peg and checked the pocket for her keys."
